# Theme 3: Supervised & Unsupervised Learning {.unnumbered}

So far you used models as black boxes. In this theme you look inside three of them. In each notebook you first train the model with scikit-learn, then build its algorithm yourself in a few lines of NumPy and check that you get the same result. Knowing how a model works helps you choose its settings and understand when it fails.

## Activities

Work through the activities in order:

1. [Linear Regression](012_linear_regression.ipynb): fitting a line, gradient descent, more than one feature, R², polynomial features and regularization.
2. [Logistic Regression](013_logistic_regression.ipynb): from a line to a probability, the log loss, the decision threshold, precision-recall and ROC curves, and more than two classes.
3. [Clustering](014_clustering.ipynb): distances and scaling, K-Means, choosing the number of clusters with the elbow and the silhouette score, and density-based clustering.

In [Theme 4](theme-4.qmd), you combine preprocessing and a model in one object.
